questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: A grandmother living in Kolkata sends her grandson a birthday card every month, while his uncle posts him a book packet along with a registered newspaper. Which statement correctly states how each item is carried? (A) Both the card and the book packet are airlifted between stations by land and air. (B) Both the card and the book packet are carried by surface mail over land and water. (C) The card is airlifted between stations by land and air, while the book packet and the newspaper travel by surface mail over land and water. (D) The card is carried by surface mail over land and water, while the book packet and the newspaper are airlifted between stations by land and air.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: The card is airlifted between stations by land and air, while the book packet and the newspaper travel by surface mail over land and water.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: The government wants air travel to become affordable for the common citizen so that airlines begin serving regional and remote routes. (a) Name the scheme it has conceived for this and give the full form of its popular name. (b) Name the ministry that conceived the scheme. (c) State the purpose of the scheme. (d) State its central idea and the two ways in which it proposes to get airlines to fly these routes.

markingPoints.description: Names the scheme as UDAN and gives its full form as Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik
States that it was conceived by the Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA), Government of India
States that the scheme is meant to promote regional connectivity by making fly affordable for the common citizen
States that the central idea is to encourage airlines to operate flights on regional and remote routes
States that this is to be done through enabling policies and extending incentives

answerScheme.modelAnswer:
Step 1: The scheme is UDAN, that is Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik.
Step 2: It was conceived by the Ministry of Civil Aviation (MoCA), Government of India.
Step 3: It is meant to promote regional connectivity by making fly affordable for the common citizen.
Step 4: Its central idea is to encourage airlines to operate flights on regional and remote routes.
Step 5: This is to be done through enabling policies and extending incentives.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem:
Rohit lives in a town far from Kolkata. Every month his grandmother in Kolkata sends him a birthday card, while his uncle posts him a book packet along with a registered newspaper. At the post office, Rohit asks the clerk why the two items are not treated alike. The clerk shows him the labels: the card is first-class mail and is airlifted between stations, while the book packet and the newspaper are second-class mail that travels by surface route. The clerk adds that six mail channels have been introduced recently so that mail reaches people quickly in large towns and cities.

(a) Name the two classes of mail Rohit receives and state how each class is carried between stations. (b) Rohit is surprised that his grandmother's card and his uncle's book packet travel in different ways; using the two classes of mail, explain why the postal network treats them differently.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: (a) First-class mail: cards and envelopes, airlifted between stations covering both land and air. Second-class mail: book packets, registered newspapers and periodicals, carried by surface mail covering land and water. (b) Personal items are sent quickly by air, while bulky low-priority items travel by surface, and six channels speed delivery in large towns and cities.
